### Borea v0.6.10

A patch release for Bazzite and other atomic Linux systems. Update with "Update now" on the Home banner, or with `borea update-self`.

[Website](https://ksamodding.github.io/Borea/) | [Discord](https://discord.gg/nt4fK4QuTz) | [Content index](https://github.com/KSAModding/content-index) | [Source and issues](https://github.com/KSAModding/Borea)

#### Installing

- On Bazzite, Fedora Silverblue, Kinoite and other atomic systems, Borea refused every install because it reported 0 bytes free. Borea now follows the folder link from `/home` into `/var` and measures the disk your library is really on. Thanks to @Skillie442 for the report.

Full changelog: [v0.6.9...v0.6.10](https://github.com/KSAModding/Borea/compare/v0.6.9...v0.6.10)
